declarations.name: idempotent_eq_one_of_one_sub_nilpotent
declarations.docstring: An idempotent is one when its complement is nilpotent.

declarations.name: finrank_associated_subtype_le
declarations.docstring: The finrank of the module subtype associated to an element is at most the finrank of the ambient algebra.

declarations.name: exists_idempotent_algEquiv_corner
declarations.docstring: Under the stated hypotheses, the second algebra is algebra equivalent to a corner subtype determined by an idempotent of the first.

declarations.name: isSimpleModule_equivalence_obj
declarations.docstring: An equivalence of module categories sends a simple module to a simple module.

declarations.name: moduleCatIsoBiproductOfIsInternal
declarations.docstring: An internal finite direct-sum decomposition induces an isomorphism from the ambient module to the biproduct of its summands.

declarations.name: simple_equivalence_obj
declarations.docstring: An equivalence between categories with zero morphisms sends a simple object to a simple object.
